issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entry: file added to TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh AND a symlink db.sh is created in the recipe
issues.detail: The PR both edits egs2/TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh to add TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads AND creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. That part is fine, but local/data.sh sources ./db.sh which yields TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads — a relative path. The script then runs `cd "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}"` before the directory exists, which fails on first run.

issues.description: data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh with `.` but passes arguments — and downloads_dir is empty by default
issues.detail: Line 35 uses `. ./local/download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"`. When downloads_dir is empty (the default), this passes an empty second arg; realpath of empty string fails under `set -euo pipefail`. Also sourcing instead of executing pollutes the parent shell and the script lacks any `exit 1` on its missing-unzip check, so failures go undetected.

issues.description: README ASR config link points to non-existent path conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml
issues.detail: README.md links `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` but the actual file is at `./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (no `train/` subdir). The link will 404 for anyone clicking it from the rendered README.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh prints a warning when unzip is missing but does not exit
issues.detail: Lines 9-11 check for unzip and echo a message, but never `exit 1`. The script then proceeds to `unzip -q ...` which fails with a less helpful error. Either exit on missing dependency or remove the misleading check.

issues.description: data.sh transcript filtering uses brittle sed pipeline and joins assume sort order alignment
issues.detail: The `paste` of `sort -u -k 1 utt_uttid` with `sort -u -k 1 transcripts.txt` aligns rows positionally, relying on identical sort keys in both files. If `filter_scp.pl` drops utterances (missing transcripts) the two sorted streams will be misaligned, silently pairing wrong audio with wrong text. Use a keyed join instead.

issues.description: Several shell scripts use unquoted command substitution and lack shebang/exec bits
issues.detail: download_and_untar.sh uses `realpath $1` and `realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}` without quoting — breaks on paths with spaces. Also `local/path.sh` only sets MAIN_ROOT and does not export it; conventional ESPnet path.sh files do more. Missing newline at end of symlink target files is harmless but flagged by linters.

review.summary: New ESPnet ASR recipe for the TAL-zh-adult-teach dataset. Main concerns are in the data preparation flow: data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh with possibly-empty args under `set -u`, and the relative `TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads` path is cd'd before being created. The transcript join logic relies on positional alignment of sorted streams, which is fragile if any utterance is filtered out. README has a broken link to the training config. Minor shell-quoting and missing-exit nits round out the review.
